verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a dedicated Access Reviews solution with pre-built content and guided workflows that "automates and accelerates the access review process" (vanta-docs-21, vanta-docs-67, vanta-docs-37). It also connects to identity providers and productivity tools (vanta-docs-26) and collects evidence automatically (vanta-docs-45), so the core capability exists first-party. However, the pack never describes how the reviews themselves work end to end. Missing for 10: documented periodic or recurring review scheduling, coverage of reviews across connected apps, in-app reviewer sign-off, completed review artifacts landing in the evidence library, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
